summary.text: Teresa Fox is the Republican challenger in Washington's 6th District, who lives in Bremerton and has worked as an emergency manager, safety professional, and fire inspector. She advanced from the August 4 primary with about 25% of the vote and describes her platform as lower taxes, less regulation, and government accountability.

paragraphs.text: Fox lives in Bremerton and is listed as a Republican. According to the Bainbridge Island Review's July 2026 candidate summary, she received an associate's degree from Olympic College, worked for the college as an environmental health and safety director, and later worked as a regional safety and health coordinator with the state Department of Labor and Industries.
Ballotpedia lists her professional experience as an emergency manager, safety professional, and fire inspector.
Fox advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 25.05% of the vote (32,006 votes) in the count reported August 6, and will face Democratic incumbent Emily Randall in the general election.
